motivation: Correct the R50G15/R50G17 saturation scope to the R33-fixed RUP-entry state H0 and prove what a complete frozen RUP pass can do to any six-variable width-6 clause without assuming exact 3x2 saturation at internal H_t states.

domain.H0: canonical tautology-free R33-fixed state at entry to one complete frozen R35B/R47J RUP pass
domain.wide_clause: any width-6 clause R over all six variables present in H0
domain.rup_semantics: frozen first_rup_strengthening + run_candidate: deterministic full rescans; successful step replaces one clause by a strict one-literal subclause; no clause widening or fresh variables

scope_correction.claim: The R50G17 p>=3,n>=2 BVE-saturation certificate is attached to H0 while H0 is R33/BVE-fixed. It is not inherited by arbitrary internal H_t states of the same RUP pass without a separate proof.
scope_correction.required_control: Replay R50G18 immediately before its seventh RUP strengthening and verify p=2,n=1,r=1 for literal 2 with BVE already accepted there.

target_theorems: BCE_FIXED_FULL_CLAUSE: for every literal l in an all-variable width6 clause R at H0 there exists a nonblocking opposite-polarity witness whose remaining literals have R polarity; hence R\{l} is RUP-valid at H0

RUP_STRENGTHENING_MONOTONICITY: if F under assumptions A unit-propagates to conflict, replacing clauses of F by subclauses cannot destroy that conflict certificate; it either reproduces the derivation or conflicts earlier
EVENTUAL_TOUCH: while a width6 R remains unchanged, every one-literal deletion stays RUP-valid; a complete frozen RUP pass therefore cannot terminate with R unchanged
FROZEN_SELECTOR: when an unchanged width6 R is first selected as source, frozen lit_key removes the literal whose variable has minimum absolute identifier among Vars(R)
RUP6_WIDTH_COLLAPSE: for a nonterminal complete RUP pass starting from H0 with exactly six variables, final maximum width is at most 5

V7_COROLLARY: in a same-pivot V7 trace, a width6 RUP-entry phase either reaches a certified safe/terminal outcome, or any surviving unsafe descendant is reduced to the already-known six-variable width5 normal form
important_nonclaim: RUP6-descended V6/W5 is not automatically the historical DIRECT5 ancestry class. R50G20 collapses width, not ancestry provenance.
